environment.vm: QEMU TCG, 4 vCPUs, 6144 MiB, isolated snapshot

measurement.units: bytes except event counts and wall_seconds
measurement.growth: Resident process RSS for native or current OE allocated heap for SGX. After each 10,000 events, before EOF refresh. Deltas are paired in each process before taking the median of three runs.
measurement.process_peak_rss: GNU time %M from process start to exit, converted from KiB
measurement.enclave_peak: OE allocator high-water footprint, including allocator slack; sampled through final output flush. This covers the whole trusted heap.
measurement.alert_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of one whole Falco JSON output line excluding its line ending
measurement.payload_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the unescaped rz.result field
measurement.upstream_comparison: Full detection objects in order. Normalize random detection ID and absolute rule installation prefix. Fixed evidence IDs and their order are compared unmodified.
measurement.process_peak_artifact: release; profiles supply intermediate RSS and enclave allocator data
